focus: Scoring the sync options against proven mechanics
noveltyJustification: Four option judgments are new derived claims and one is a new absence finding; the remaining claims restate iteration 9 and 13 evidence, and the bonus reflects one two-hop model replacing five candidate options.
answeredQuestions: How should a Product Owner copy of mcp-figma be embedded, plugin-packaged and synced back to .skilled across two repositories?
ruledOut: Symlinks or submodules for the embedded skill

findings.label: Build-output duplication with a source-difference refusal is the only locally demonstrated drift-proof pattern: the plugin copies the skill each build, replaces the folder, and fails when any copied file differs.
Vendored copies with an explicit declaration are the fallback when generation is impossible, as Product Owner already does for four shared rule cards.
Symlinks are disproven: a link climbing out of the repository resolves to nothing once cloned, and the plugin build refuses links in an unpacked payload.
No local precedent exists for sharing a skill through a submodule, subtree merge or published package; neither precedent uses one and no record mentions one.

The skill-to-copy hop is generatable because both ends are tracked files; the copy-to-Project hop is not, because the contract requires a per-paragraph human decision and a named reviewer's dated record.
The best available path is one generated hop with a refusal plus one manual hop with a dated record; claiming fully automated sync would abandon the manual parity contract.
